purpose: Determine exactly what, if anything, is already proven among the three candidates selected by the frozen V58 global 795-trial ledger, while separating historical gross persistence from modern investability and operational readiness.
selection_rule: No new candidate selection. Candidate set is exactly the three rows labeled SURVIVES_GLOBAL_GROSS_ONLY in research_v58/ledgers/V58_GLOBAL_TRIAL_LEDGER.csv.
input: research_v58/data/PredictorLSretWide.csv, maintained Open Source Asset Pricing all-stock long-short portfolio returns through 2024-12
estimator: OLS intercept with HAC covariance, max lag 6

multiple_testing.family: 3 candidates x 2 splits x 2 confirmation views = 12 one-sided tests
multiple_testing.candidate selection caveat: The three candidates were selected using V58 maintained portfolio outcomes. Results are confirmation of claim scope, not an independent fresh-data replication.

primary_gate.historical_gross_market_claim_proven: factor-controlled alpha > 0 and simultaneous adjusted lower bound > 0 in original validation and lockbox; all leave-one-decade-out alphas > 0 in lockbox
primary_gate.modern_all_stock_gross_claim_proven: factor-controlled alpha > 0 and simultaneous adjusted lower bound > 0 in 2006-2014 and 2015-2024

secondary_stress.note: Hurdles are diagnostic, not a substitute for signal-specific turnover, spread, borrow, and market-impact estimates.

forbidden: calling maintained aggregate portfolio evidence a point-in-time ticker selector
promoting capital permission without alternative portfolio construction, PIT stock data, capacity, and prospective evidence
